title: v0.31.0: recipe CI smoke-train validation for multi-GPU recipes
body:
## Context

v0.27.0 adds 3 multi-GPU recipes:
- `llama3-70b-fsdp2` (requires 8x A100/H100 80GB)
- `qwen3-32b-zeropp` (requires 4+ GPUs with NVLink/NVSwitch)
- `deepseek-v3-pipeline` (requires 4+ GPUs, pipeline exec deferred to v0.27.1)

Today these recipes load cleanly as config (`test_multi_gpu.py::TestMultiGpuRecipes` verifies schema + fields) but are **not exercised by a 100-step CI smoke-train** — upstream tokenizer / model-loader changes could silently break them.

## Proposal for v0.31.0 (per plan roadmap)

From the roadmap:
> **Recipe verification CI** — every recipe runs a 100-step smoke train in CI to catch regressions from upstream model changes.

Scope for multi-GPU specifically:
- Use Modal.com or Lambda Labs free credits for one 4xA100 runner
- Run 100-step smoke train for each multi-GPU recipe, assert loss decreased
- Gate CI on this (fail PR if smoke train regresses)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New workflow `.github/workflows/recipe-smoke-train.yml`
- [ ] Runs on release branches only (not every push — cost)
- [ ] Matrix over the 3 multi-GPU recipes
- [ ] Artifact: final-step loss + wall-clock
- [ ] Fails the release if any recipe's loss trajectory regresses >20% vs last recorded baseline

## Risk notes

- GPU runner cost — need a sponsor or free-credit strategy (Modal startup program, Lambda research credits)
- Smoke train != full train — 100 steps is too short to catch some regressions, but catches tokenizer / loader / quant breaks

comments.body:
v0.31.0 ships the **CPU-only validation tier** of recipe CI: `.github/workflows/recipe-validation.yml` runs the parametrized pytest validation (`tests/test_recipes_v031.py`) on every PR + push touching recipe / config / data code. This catches:

- Schema regressions (Pydantic config rejecting a recipe yaml)
- Catalog/yaml drift (`RecipeMeta.model` ≠ yaml `base:`)
- Unsafe model IDs (`..` / `://` / null bytes / backslashes)
- Empty `lora.target_modules` (silent no-op LoRA)
- `max_length` out of bounds
- GRPO recipes missing `reward_fn` or `num_generations`
- Vision recipes missing `image_dir`; audio recipes missing `audio_dir`

See [release notes](https://github.com/MakazhanAlpamys/Soup/releases/tag/v0.31.0).

The **100-step live smoke-train tier** (matrix over `llama3-70b-fsdp2` / `qwen3-32b-zeropp` / `deepseek-v3-pipeline`) requires a GPU runner and is **deferred to v0.31.1** — keeping this issue open as the tracker for that follow-up.

Adding `infra-blocked`: the part still open is the 100-step live smoke-train of the three multi-GPU recipes, which needs a 4-8 GPU runner (and a credit or sponsor plan) that the local harness does not have. The CPU-only validation tier already ships, as the 2026-04-25 comment says.
